plan.title: Gender Comparison of Improvement
plan.subtitle: Average sit-up count improvement from baseline to endline by gender

panels.title: Average Sit-ups Improvement by Gender
panels.sql: SELECT e.Gender, AVG(e."Sit ups" - b."Sit ups") AS avg_improvement FROM endline e JOIN baseline b ON e."Child ID" = b."Child ID" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY avg_improvement DESC

plan.narrative: The dashboard presents a single bar chart comparing the average improvement in sit-up counts between girls and boys. The improvement is calculated as the difference between the endline and baseline sit-up counts for each child. The chart allows a direct visual comparison of whether girls and boys are improving equally. The numeric value shown for each gender can be referenced as {{p1.0.avg_improvement}} for females and {{p1.1.avg_improvement}} for males, indicating the magnitude of improvement for each group.
